title: Note that notificationsEnabled is now load-bearing
start_anchor: data class AppSettings(val notificationsEnabled: Boolean = true)
description: Previously this field was stored/displayed but never consulted before scheduling a reminder. It now gates whether logDose() schedules the next-dose reminder (default source for the per-dose notify-on-next-dose toggle) -- worth a comment so a future reader doesn't assume it's still decorative.
acceptance_criteria: A short comment precedes the AppSettings data class explaining it's now load-bearing
The data class declaration itself (name, field, default) is unchanged
